title: hockeypuck: add NGI team
reason: Applicable by the letter of the rule: changed-file list includes nixos/modules/services/security/hockeypuck.nix and a wired test exists (nixos/tests/all-tests.nix at head 928065b6a contains 'hockeypuck = runTest ./hockeypuck.nix;', line 796). HOWEVER the real diff to both hockeypuck.nix and hockeypuck.nix (test) is maintainer-list-only: `meta.maintainers = [ ];` -> `meta.maintainers = lib.teams.ngi.members;` in both files. No mkOption/mkEnableOption/mkRenamedOptionModule declaration line is touched anywhere in the diff (full diff also touches pkgs/by-name/ho/hockeypuck{,-web}/package.nix, package-only). Only baseline `enable` was watched, as no option-declaration line changed.
targets_toml: single target hockeypuck, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,hockeypuck], watch=[enable].
